verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ γίνωσκε ὅτι ἐν ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις ἐνστήσονται καιροὶ χαλεποί
verses.transliteration: Touto de ginōske hoti en eschatais hēmerais enstēsontai kairoi chalepoi
verses.literal: But understand this In the last days terrible times will come
verses.literalPt: Sabe, porém, isto, que nos últimos dias, virão tempos difíceis;

verses.original: ἔσονται γὰρ οἱ ἄνθρωποι φίλαυτοι φιλάργυροι ἀλαζόνες ὑπερήφανοι βλάσφημοι γονεῦσιν ἀπειθεῖς ἀχάριστοι ἀνόσιοι
verses.transliteration: esontai gar hoi anthrōpoi philautoi philargyroi alazones hyperēphanoi blasphēmoi goneusin apeitheis acharistoi anosioi
verses.literal: For men will be lovers of themselves lovers of money boastful arrogant abusive disobedient to their parents ungrateful unholy
verses.literalPt: pois os homens serão amantes de si mesmos, avarentos, pretensiosos, soberbos, maldizentes, desobedientes a seus pais, ingratos, ímpios,

verses.original: ἄστοργοι ἄσπονδοι διάβολοι ἀκρατεῖς ἀνήμεροι ἀφιλάγαθοι
verses.transliteration: astorgoi aspondoi diaboloi akrateis anēmeroi aphilagathoi
verses.literal: unloving unforgiving slanderous without self-control brutal without love of good
verses.literalPt: sem afeição natural, implacáveis, caluniadores, incontinentes, cruéis, inimigos do bem,

verses.original: προδόται προπετεῖς τετυφωμένοι φιλήδονοι μᾶλλον ἢ φιλόθεοι
verses.transliteration: prodotai propeteis tetyphōmenoi philēdonoi mallon ē philotheoi
verses.literal: traitorous reckless conceited lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God
verses.literalPt: traidores, insolentes, presunçosos, amando mais os prazeres do que a Deus,

verses.original: ἔχοντες μόρφωσιν εὐσεβείας τὴν δὲ δύναμιν αὐτῆς ἠρνημένοι καὶ τούτους ἀποτρέπου
verses.transliteration: echontes morphōsin eusebeias tēn de dynamin autēs ērnēmenoi kai toutous apotrepou
verses.literal: having a form of godliness but denying its power Turn away from such as these
verses.literalPt: tendo a aparência de piedade, porém negando o poder dela. Foge também desses homens.

verses.original: Ἐκ τούτων γάρ εἰσιν οἱ ἐνδύνοντες εἰς τὰς οἰκίας καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες γυναικάρια σεσωρευμένα ἁμαρτίαις ἀγόμενα ἐπιθυμίαις ποικίλαις
verses.transliteration: Ek toutōn gar eisin hoi endynontes eis tas oikias kai aichmalōtizontes gynaikaria sesōreumena hamartiais agomena epithymiais poikilais
verses.literal: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions
verses.literalPt: Pois deste número são os que se introduzem nas casas e cativam as mulherinhas carregadas de pecados, seduzidas por toda sorte de paixões,

verses.original: πάντοτε μανθάνοντα καὶ μηδέποτε εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν δυνάμενα
verses.transliteration: pantote manthanonta kai mēdepote eis epignōsin alētheias elthein dynamena
verses.literal: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth
verses.literalPt: aprendendo sempre, mas nunca podendo chegar ao pleno conhecimento da verdade.

verses.original: ὃν τρόπον δὲ Ἰάννης καὶ Ἰαμβρῆς ἀντέστησαν Μωϋσεῖ οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι ἀνθίστανται τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἄνθρωποι κατεφθαρμένοι τὸν νοῦν ἀδόκιμοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν
verses.transliteration: hon tropon de Iannēs kai Iambrēs antestēsan Mōusei houtōs kai houtoi anthistantai tē alētheia anthrōpoi katephtharmenoi ton noun adokimoi peri tēn pistin
verses.literal: Just as . . . . . . Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses so also these men oppose the truth They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith
verses.literalPt: Assim como Janes e Jambres resistiram a Moisés, assim também estes resistem à verdade, sendo homens corrompidos de entendimento e réprobos quanto à fé.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐ προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἡ γὰρ ἄνοια αὐτῶν ἔκδηλος ἔσται πᾶσιν ὡς καὶ ἡ ἐκείνων ἐγένετο
verses.transliteration: all’ ou prokopsousin epi pleion hē gar anoia autōn ekdēlos estai pasin hōs kai hē ekeinōn egeneto
verses.literal: But they will not advance much further For just like Jannes and Jambres their folly will be plain to everyone
verses.literalPt: Não irão, porém, avante, porque a sua insensatez será manifestada a todos, como foi a daqueles homens.

verses.original: Σὺ δὲ παρηκολούθησάς μου τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ τῇ ἀγωγῇ τῇ προθέσει τῇ πίστει τῇ μακροθυμίᾳ τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ὑπομονῇ
verses.transliteration: Sy de parēkolouthēsas mou tē didaskalia tē agōgē tē prothesei tē pistei tē makrothymia tē agapē tē hypomonē
verses.literal: You however have observed my teaching my conduct my purpose my faith my patience my love my perseverance
verses.literalPt: Tu, porém, seguiste de perto o meu ensino, procedimento, intenção, fé, longanimidade, amor, perseverança,

verses.original: τοῖς διωγμοῖς τοῖς παθήμασιν οἷά μοι ἐγένετο ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ ἐν Ἰκονίῳ ἐν Λύστροις οἵους διωγμοὺς ὑπήνεγκα καὶ ἐκ πάντων με ἐρρύσατο ὁ Κύριος
verses.transliteration: tois diōgmois tois pathēmasin hoia moi egeneto en Antiocheia en Ikoniō en Lystrois hoious diōgmous hypēnenka kai ek pantōn me errysato ho Kyrios
verses.literal: my persecutions and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch Iconium and Lystra What persecutions I endured Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them
verses.literalPt: as minhas perseguições e sofrimentos, quais me aconteceram em Antioquia, Icônio e Listra; quais as perseguições que sofri; e como de todas elas me livrou o Senhor.

verses.original: καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ θέλοντες ζῆν εὐσεβῶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διωχθήσονται
verses.transliteration: kai pantes de hoi thelontes zēn eusebōs en Christō Iēsou diōchthēsontai
verses.literal: Indeed all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted
verses.literalPt: Ora, todos aqueles que querem viver piamente em Cristo Jesus serão perseguidos.

verses.original: πονηροὶ δὲ ἄνθρωποι καὶ γόητες προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖρον πλανῶντες καὶ πλανώμενοι
verses.transliteration: ponēroi de anthrōpoi kai goētes prokopsousin epi to cheiron planōntes kai planōmenoi
verses.literal: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse deceiving and being deceived
verses.literalPt: Mas os homens maus e impostores se tornarão cada vez piores, iludindo e sendo iludidos.

verses.original: Σὺ δὲ μένε ἐν οἷς ἔμαθες καὶ ἐπιστώθης εἰδὼς παρὰ τίνων ἔμαθες
verses.transliteration: Sy de mene en hois emathes kai epistōthēs eidōs para tinōn emathes
verses.literal: But as for you continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed since you know from whom you have learned them
verses.literalPt: Tu, porém, persevera nas coisas que aprendeste e de que tens a certeza, sabendo de quem as aprendeste.

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ βρέφους τὰ ἱερὰ γράμματα οἶδας τὰ δυνάμενά σε σοφίσαι εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ πίστεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hoti apo brephous ta hiera grammata oidas ta dynamena se sophisai eis sōtērian dia pisteōs tēs en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: E que, desde a infância, sabes as sagradas letras, que te podem instruir para a salvação pela fé que é em Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: πᾶσα γραφὴ θεόπνευστος καὶ ὠφέλιμος πρὸς διδασκαλίαν πρὸς ἐλεγμόν πρὸς ἐπανόρθωσιν πρὸς παιδείαν τὴν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ
verses.transliteration: pasa graphē theopneustos kai ōphelimos pros didaskalian pros elegmon pros epanorthōsin pros paideian tēn en dikaiosynē
verses.literal: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction for conviction for correction and for training in righteousness
verses.literalPt: Toda a Escritura divinamente inspirada é também útil para ensinar, para repreender, para corrigir e para instruir na justiça,

verses.original: ἵνα ἄρτιος ᾖ ὁ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἄνθρωπος πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐξηρτισμένος
verses.transliteration: hina artios ē ho tou Theou anthrōpos pros pan ergon agathon exērtismenos
verses.literal: so that the man of God may be complete fully equipped for every good work
verses.literalPt: a fim de que o homem de Deus seja perfeito, plenamente preparado para toda boa obra.
